subtitle: Pauses the game while the pause screen or settings are open, so mobs, projectiles and environmental damage wait for you.
description:
Switch off "Pause Screen Only" in the Mods tab of the game's settings to also pause while the inventory, map or quests are open. Your character in the inventory keeps animating.

It only works in offline saves. In online saves the game keeps running as normal, even when you play alone.

For mod makers: blueprint mods are paused too while one of these menus is open. If your mod needs to keep running in menus, for example to update the character preview, call Set Tickable When Paused (true) on your ModActor in Begin Play, and on any actors or components it relies on.

Requirements

  • Blueprint Loader, which loads this mod

Install

  1. Close the game, and fully close the Minecraft Launcher if you use it.
  2. Open your Minecraft Dungeons II Paks folder.
    • Steam: Right click the game in your library, then Manage > Browse local files, then open Dungeons\Content\Paks
    • Minecraft Launcher: C:\XboxGames\Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks
    If you picked a different install folder in the Minecraft Launcher, it is Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks inside that folder.
  3. Create a folder called ~mods inside the Paks folder if there is not one already.
  4. Open the zip and move the PauseInMenus folder inside it into ~mods, so the files end up like this: Paks\~mods\PauseInMenus\PauseInMenus_P.pak

Uninstall

Delete the PauseInMenus folder from ~mods.
